result.question: Before I trust any DGA numbers from Transformer 1 at site MAIN, confirm the transformer is registered at that site. Then compare the sensors assigned to it with the fields that actually show up in its data stream. List any assigned sensor that never reports a value, and for each measured channel give its non-null count and first and last timestamps. Pay particular attention to hydrogen, methane, ethane, ethylene, acetylene, co and co2, and tell me which of these have enough data for a fault interpretation, meaning at least 3 non-null samples. If any of those seven gases is assigned but never measured, name it and say which remaining gas can stand in for it. Use hydrogen for acetylene, ethane for methane, and co2 for co.
result.answer:
Transformer 1 is registered at MAIN, and all seven DGA gases have enough data for a fault interpretation, so no substitutions are needed.

**Registration:** MAIN has 6 assets: Chiller 6, Motor_01, PUMP3, Transformer 1, hyd_1 and mp_1.

**Assigned vs. measured:** 30 sensors are assigned, and all 30 show up in the data stream. No other fields appear in the data. Every assigned sensor reports a value.

**Measured channels:** The stream has only 5 records. Each of the 30 channels has a value in all 5, and every value is a real number. For every channel, the first timestamp is 2024-01-15T00:00:00 and the last is 2024-01-19T00:00:00.

| Channel | Non-null | First | Last |
|---|---|---|---|
| hydrogen, methane, ethane, ethylene, acetylene, co, co2 | 5 each | 2024-01-15 | 2024-01-19 |
| oxygen, nitrogen, dbds, power_factor, interfacial_v, dielectric_rigidity, water_content | 5 each | 2024-01-15 | 2024-01-19 |
| vl1, vl2, vl3, il1, il2, il3, vl12, vl23, vl31, inut, rated_mva | 5 each | 2024-01-15 | 2024-01-19 |
| wti, oti, ati, oti_a, oti_t | 5 each | 2024-01-15 | 2024-01-19 |

**The seven gases:**

| Gas | Samples | Range (ppm) | Enough (≥3)? |
|---|---|---|---|
| hydrogen | 5 | 2800–2950 | Yes |
| methane | 5 | 7200–7406 | Yes |
| ethane | 5 | 5400–5500 | Yes |
| ethylene | 5 | 16500–16700 | Yes |
| acetylene | 5 | 6–8 | Yes |
| co | 5 | 30–35 | Yes |
| co2 | 5 | 1300–1350 | Yes |

**Stand-ins:** None of the seven gases is assigned without being measured. Hydrogen doesn't need to stand in for acetylene, ethane for methane, or co2 for co.

**Before you rely on it:** The whole record is only 5 daily samples, from 2024-01-15 to 2024-01-19. That clears the 3-sample minimum, but the data is over two and a half years old. The oil temperature trip flag (oti_t) is also on in all 5 records.
